verdict.rationale: Cekura explicitly supports 'Python metric' evaluators, allowing custom evaluation code with 'complete control' (cekura-docs-8), alongside conditional/rule-based evaluators (cekura-docs-22), rubric-based criteria (cekura-docs-32), and LLM-judge metrics (cekura-docs-9), giving ML engineers multiple ways to define custom scorers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of writing a custom Python scorer and integration examples showing it in a full eval pipeline beyond docs.
